name: cgm-dashboard
description: CGM kiosk dashboard for an old phone: static files on GitHub Pages, the browser talks to Dexcom Share directly. Credentials never leave the phone.

scripts.test:e2e: docker run --rm --ipc=host -u "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp -e CI=1 -v "$PWD":/work -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v$(node -p "require('@playwright/test/package.json').version")-noble npx playwright test
